author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to explore the impact UE5 had on the development of ‘Valor Mortis’: an innovative, original title set in an alternate 19th-century Europe.

Developed by One More Level, ‘Valor Mortis’ is an all-new first-person action Soulslike where players rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army to wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

Find out how UE5 helped bring the Napoleonic-era locations, weapons, and outfits to life—and how specific UE5 features such as Nanite, Lumen, and Niagara helped craft the game’s Metroidvania-inspired levels and dynamic visual effects.

Find out more about developing games with Unreal Engine here: https://unrealengine.com/uses/games
